description: MainActivity class implementing a simple login, sign-up, and calculator UI logic for an Android app.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity managing user authentication and calculator functions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, binds views, wires events, seeds demo account, and shows login screen.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Associates UI components with code variables.

methods.name: wireEvents
methods.description: Sets click listeners for UI buttons.

methods.name: showDashboard
methods.description: Displays dashboard UI with welcome message.

methods.name: attemptLogin
methods.description: Validates login credentials and navigates to dashboard on success.

methods.name: attemptSignUp
methods.description: Validates sign-up data, creates account, and navigates to dashboard.

methods.name: clearCalculatorState
methods.description: Resets calculator input and output fields.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Performs selected arithmetic operation on input numbers.

methods.name: parseDoubleOrNull
methods.description: Parses string to Double, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats number for display, removing unnecessary decimal.
